'''Orange Blossom Cherbet''' ({{lang|ar|شربات ماء زهر}}, ''Cherbet Mazhar'') is a refreshing Algerian drink. It originates from Algiers and is also called ''Cherbet Khotba'' (Proposal Cherbet) as it is only served during marriage proposals as per Algiers' traditions.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Liter|L]] of fresh water
* 1 large glass of [[Cookbook:Orange Flower Water|orange blossom water]]
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] of [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]] (depending on taste)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] of [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] powder
* 1 stick of cinnamon

== Procedure ==
# Combine water and orange blossom water in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium heat. Stir with a wooden spoon. 
# Add the cinnamon powder and stir until it fully dilutes. Then add the sugar, and mix everything well.
# When the sugar is completely dissolved, transfer the drink to a pitcher and let it cool in the fridge. Serve with [[Cookbook:Quince|quince]] [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]] or seasonal fruit.
